name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-guided-list-form
title: Guided List Form
shortDescription: A one-question-per-screen form that adds an item to any SharePoint custom list, as a page web part or inline in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, without sending answers back to the model.
longDescription: Guided List Form is a conversational, one-question-at-a-time wizard that creates one item in one SharePoint custom list. The same React UI ships as a page web part (BaseClientSideWebPart) and as a Copilot UX component (BaseCopilotComponent) called through the open_step_by_step_form tool with static tool discovery.

In Copilot, a site and list picker (followed and recent sites, plus a same-tenant name search) appears when no list is supplied. Change list returns to that picker. After submit, a copy-link control copies the new item address to the clipboard. The person always reviews and submits; Copilot cannot submit and receives only status text, never answers or item content.

The package requests no API permissions. Model-supplied site URLs must be https on the current tenant. Supported columns include text, choice, Yes/No, number, currency, date and time, and https hyperlinks. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required for the Copilot host.
